highlights: 30 years as an Elton John tribute, lookalike and singer
Setlist built around your favourite Elton John songs
Can host your event as well as perform
Covers East London, Essex, Kent, Hertfordshire and the M25
New 'George 'n' Elton' tribute show also available

goodToKnow.text: Allow at least three months' notice: that is the lead time his FAQ recommends for securing a preferred date.
He can bring a basic set-up of microphones and speakers; larger technical requirements may need to be arranged separately.
His website says it is under construction and asks clients to book by text message or through Instagram (@eltonrayjohnson). The site also has an enquiry form.
His site describes the act as covering East London, Essex, Kent, Hertfordshire and the M25 area.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.a: His FAQ recommends booking at least three months ahead to secure your preferred date.

faqs.q: Can we request specific Elton John songs?
faqs.a: Yes. The setlist can be customised to include your favourite Elton John songs.
He can provide basic equipment such as microphones and speakers. Anything beyond that may need to be arranged separately.

faqs.q: Can he host our event as well as perform?
faqs.a: Yes. Event hosting is one of the services on his site, which pitches it as a way to take the stress out of hosting by having the performer as your host.
His site lists East London, Essex, Kent, Hertfordshire and the M25 area.

faqs.q: What kinds of events does he perform at?
faqs.a: His About page says he is available for a variety of events, from intimate pub gigs to grand weddings, and that performances can be customised.
His homepage says the site is under construction and asks clients to get in touch by text message or on Instagram at @eltonrayjohnson. There is also an enquiry form on the website.

serviceDetails.name: Live Elton John tribute performances
serviceDetails.more: His biography describes a show that recreates Elton John's look and stage presence as well as the energy of his music, with audiences invited to sing along to the hits.

serviceDetails.name: George 'n' Elton show
serviceDetails.more: His site describes the opening George 'n' Elton show at the Comrades Club and invites anyone interested to get in touch for details.

notes: All nine pages in the site's sitemap were fetched on 27 Oct 2026. The site publishes no prices, packages, set lengths, deposit, cancellation, travel-charge, space, power or insurance details. The Testimonials page holds only placeholder template tiers (Basic/Professional/Business/Enterprise), and the 'Business cards and banners' and 'Ray on Radio Elton John' pages have no text. No step-by-step booking process is described, so howItWorks is empty. The homepage gives the location as Theydon Bois and the contact page gives Chigwell. The one testimonial on the homepage (a birthday party) was not used as a business statement. The YouTube promo's watch page has no description text. Phone numbers and email addresses on the site were deliberately left out.
